title: cleisostoma rugosulum
intro: Cleisostoma rugosulum, commonly known as the wrinkled cleisostoma, is a type of orchid native to Southeast Asia. It is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Research suggests that it may also exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and cytotoxic activities, although more studies are needed to confirm these effects. The bioactive constituents of Cleisostoma rugosulum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
